title: Rama obtains Kausalya's permission
introduction: In this chapter Kausalya requests Rama to take her to forest also. But Rama stops Kausalya saying that service of husband is the ultimate dharma of wife and he obtains her permission for him to go to forest.
closing: Thus completes twenty fourth chapter of Ayodhya kanda in Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
तम् समीक्ष्य तु अवहितम् पितुर् निर्देश पालने |
कौसल्या बाष्प सम्रुद्धा वचो धर्मिष्ठम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tam samīkṣya tu avahitam pitur nirdeśa pālane |
kausalyā bāṣpa samruddhā vaco dharmiṣṭham abravīt
verses.translation: Seeing him firm minded in protecting the command of his father, Kausalya in a choked voice spoke these righteous words:

verses.devanagari:
अदृष्ट दुह्खो धर्मात्मा सर्व भूत प्रियम् वदः |
मयि जातः दशरथात् कथम् उन्चेन वर्तयेत्
verses.iast:
adṛṣṭa duhkho dharmātmā sarva bhūta priyam vadaḥ |
mayi jātaḥ daśarathāt katham uncena vartayet
verses.translation: �Rama who is born in me and Dasaratha, is a righteous person. He speaks lovingly to all beings. He has not faced grief at any time. How can such a person live in a forest, by gathering grains ?'

glosses.meaning: who speaks lovingly to all beings
by gathering grains fallen on floor ?

verses.devanagari:
यस्य भृत्याः च दासाः च मृष्टानि अन्नानि भुन्जते |
कथम् स भोक्ष्यते नाथो वने मूल फलानि अयम्
verses.iast:
yasya bhṛtyāḥ ca dāsāḥ ca mṛṣṭāni annāni bhunjate |
katham sa bhokṣyate nātho vane mūla phalāni ayam
verses.translation: "While the dependants and the servants of Lord Rama eat pleasant foods all the while, how can he eat roots and fruits himself in the forest ?"

glosses.meaning: how ayam = such Rama naatha = the lord
can eat muulaphalaani = roots and fruits vane = in forest ?

verses.devanagari:
क एतत् श्रद्दधेत् श्रुत्वा कस्य वा न भवेद् भयम् |
गुणवान् दयितः राज्ञो राघवो यद् विवास्यते
verses.iast:
ka etat śraddadhet śrutvā kasya vā na bhaved bhayam |
guṇavān dayitaḥ rāGYo rāghavo yad vivāsyate
verses.translation: "Hearing that Rama the beloved and virtuous is being thus sent to exile by the king , who will believe these words? Who will not develop fear ?"

glosses.meaning: is being sent to exile thus

verses.devanagari:
नूनम् तु बलवान् लोके कृतान्तः सर्वमादिशन् |
लोके रामाभिरामस्त्वम् वनम् यत्र गमिष्यसि
verses.iast:
nūnam tu balavān loke kṛtāntaḥ sarvamādiśan |
loke rāmābhirāmastvam vanam yatra gamiśhyasi
verses.translation: �Oh, Rama ! If you , the charming in the world are to go to exile , then it can be certainly said that everything is ordered by a strong destiny'

verses.devanagari:
अयम् तु मामात्मभवस्तवादर्शनमारुतः |
विलापदुःखसमिधो रुदिताश्रुहुताहुतिः
चिन्ताबाष्पमहाधूस्तवागमनचिन्तजः |
कर्शयित्वा भृशम् पुत्र निश्वासायाससम्भवः
त्वया विहीनाम् इह माम् शोक अग्निर् अतुलो महान् |
प्रधक्ष्यति यथा कक्षम् चित्र भानुर् हिम अत्यये
verses.iast:
ayam tu māmātmabhavastavādarśanamārutaḥ |
vilāpaduḥkhasamidho ruditāśruhutāhutiḥ
cintābāśhpamahādhūstavāgamanacintajaḥ |
karśayitvā bhṛśam putra niśvāsāyāsasambhavaḥ
tvayā vihīnām iha mām śoka agnir atulo mahān |
pradhakṣyati yathā kakṣam citra bhānur hima atyaye
verses.translation: "Oh, Son! Soon after your departure to a distant forest, a great and incomparable fire of sorrow will generate in my whole body. The wind which flares it up is your not being seen here. My lamentation and grief are the fire-sticks. My wailing tears will be the offerings as an oblation to fire. The choking and anxiety will be a great smoke .The thought that when you would return, will generate smoke again. Such a fire of grief will make me emaciated completely and will burn like dry wood by fire in winter.'

glosses.meaning: which is originating in the whole body
having wind of your not being seen
having fire - twigs of lamentation and grief
having offering of wailing tears as oblation to fire
having great smoke of choking caused by anxiety
generated out of the thought of your return
created out of sigh and fatigue

verses.devanagari:
कथम् हि धेनुः स्वम् वत्सम् गच्चन्तम् न अनुगच्चति |
अहम् त्वा अनुगमिष्यामि यत्र पुत्र गमिष्यसि
verses.iast:
katham hi dhenuḥ svam vatsam gaccantam na anugaccati |
aham tvā anugamiṣyāmi yatra putra gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: "Oh, Son! A cow follows its calf wherever it goes. So also, I shall come with you wherever you go."'

verses.devanagari:
तथा निगदितम् मात्रा तत् वाक्यम् पुरुष ऱ्षभः |
श्रुत्वा रामः अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् मातरम् भृश दुह्खिताम् ||
verses.iast:
tathā nigaditam mātrā tat vākyam puruṣa Rṣabhaḥ |
śrutvā rāmaḥ abravīd vākyam mātaram bhṛśa duhkhitām ||
verses.translation: "Oh, son! A cow follows its calf wherever it goes. So also, I shall come with you wherever you go."

verses.devanagari:
कैकेय्या वन्चितः राजा मयि च अरण्यम् आश्रिते |
भवत्या च परित्यक्तः न नूनम् वर्तयिष्यति
verses.iast:
kaikeyyā vancitaḥ rājā mayi ca araṇyam āśrite |
bhavatyā ca parityaktaḥ na nūnam vartayiṣyati
verses.translation: "Kaikeyi already deceived the king .He will not be alive, when I leave for the forest and you also leave him .It is certain."

verses.devanagari:
भर्तुः किल परित्यागो नृशंसः केवलम् स्त्रियाः |
स भवत्या न कर्तव्यो मनसा अपि विगर्हितः
verses.iast:
bhartuḥ kila parityāgo nṛśaṃsaḥ kevalam striyāḥ |
sa bhavatyā na kartavyo manasā api vigarhitaḥ
verses.translation: "To a woman, abandonment of husband is entirely a cruel act. That bad act is not to be perceived even by mind."

verses.devanagari:
यावज् जीवति काकुत्स्थः पिता मे जगती पतिः |
शुश्रूषा क्रियताम् तावत् स हि धर्मः सनातनः
verses.iast:
yāvaj jīvati kākutsthaḥ pitā me jagatī patiḥ |
śuśrūṣā kriyatām tāvat sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: "Till Dasaratha, my father and the great king is alive, you should serve him well. It is eternal justice."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु रामेण कौसल्या शुभ दर्शना |
तथा इति उवाच सुप्रीता रामम् अक्लिष्ट कारिणम्
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu rāmeṇa kausalyā śubha darśanā |
tathā iti uvāca suprītā rāmam akliṣṭa kāriṇam
verses.translation: After Rama spoke thus, Kausalya with auspicious appearance, was very much pleased and spoke to Rama, who performs indefatigable actions, in consent.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु वचनम् रामः धर्मभ्ऱ्ताम् वरः |
भूयः ताम् अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् मातरम् भृश दुह्खिताम्
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu vacanam rāmaḥ dharmabhRtām varaḥ |
bhūyaḥ tām abravīd vākyam mātaram bhṛśa duhkhitām
verses.translation: That Rama, the best among upholders of righteousness, after hearing the words of his mother ,spoke again to her who was very much distressed.

glosses.meaning: the best among upholders of righteousness

verses.devanagari:
मया चैव भवत्या च कर्तव्यम् वचनम् पितुः |
राजा भर्ता गुरुः श्रेष्ठः सर्वेषाम् ईश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.iast:
mayā caiva bhavatyā ca kartavyam vacanam pituḥ |
rājā bhartā guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarveṣām īśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "The words of father are to be followed by you and me. For all, he is the king, the nourished, a venerable man, the best among men, the lord and the ruler."

verses.devanagari:
इमानि तु महा अरण्ये विह्ऱ्त्य नव पन्च च |
वर्षाणि परम प्रीतः स्थास्यामि वचने तव
verses.iast:
imāni tu mahā araṇye vihRtya nava panca ca |
varṣāṇi parama prītaḥ sthāsyāmi vacane tava
verses.translation: "After roaming in the great forest for fourteen years, I shall come back and very gladly stand by your command."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता प्रियम् पुत्रम् बाष्प पूर्ण आनना तदा |
उवाच परम आर्ता तु कौसल्या पुत्र वत्सला
verses.iast:
evam uktā priyam putram bāṣpa pūrṇa ānanā tadā |
uvāca parama ārtā tu kausalyā putra vatsalā
verses.translation: After hearing the words of Rama, Kausalya who was affectionate to her son , was in great sorrow with her face filled with tears and spoke thus to her beloved son Rama .

glosses.meaning: who is affectionate to her son

verses.devanagari:
आसाम् राम सपत्नीनाम् वस्तुम् मध्ये न मे क्षमम् |
नय माम् अपि काकुत्स्थ वनम् वन्यम् म्ऱ्गीम् यथा
यदि ते गमने बुद्धिः कृता पितुर् अपेक्षया |
verses.iast:
āsām rāma sapatnīnām vastum madhye na me kṣamam |
naya mām api kākutstha vanam vanyam mRgīm yathā
yadi te gamane buddhiḥ kṛtā pitur apekṣayā |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! I can not reside in the middle of these step-wives. If you have made up your mind to go to forest as per your father's wish ,also take me, like taking a female deer of the forest ,to the woods ''

glosses.meaning: like female deer vanyaam = belonging to forest

verses.devanagari:
ताम् तथा रुदतीम् रामः रुदन् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
जीवन्त्या हि स्त्रिया भर्ता दैवतम् प्रभुर् एव च |
verses.iast:
tām tathā rudatīm rāmaḥ rudan vacanam abravīt
jīvantyā hi striyā bhartā daivatam prabhur eva ca |
verses.translation: "Rama spoke thus these words bemoaningly to her, who was weeping= "as long as a woman is alive ,her husband is god and master to her".

verses.devanagari:
भवत्या मम चैवाद्य राजा प्रभवति प्रभुः ।।
न ह्यनाथा वयं राज्ज्ञा लोकनाथेन धीम ता ।
verses.iast:
bhavatyā mama caivādya rājā prabhavati prabhuḥ
na hyanāthā vayaṃ rājJṇā lokanāthena dhīma tā |
verses.translation: "King Dasaratha, supreme commander has authority over you and me also now. when king, the lord of the earth and the wise man is there , we are not indeed master-less.'

glosses.meaning: lord of the earth dhiimataa = the wise man''.

verses.devanagari:
भरतश्चापि धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतप्रियंवदः ।।
भवतीमनुवर्तेत स हिधर्मरतः सदा ।
verses.iast:
bharataścāpi dharmātmā sarvabhūtapriyaṃvadaḥ
bhavatīmanuvarteta sa hidharmarataḥ sadā |
verses.translation: "Bharata also, who is a righteous person and who speaks lovingly to all beings will be obliging to you. He is indeed always devoted to righteousness.'

glosses.meaning: who speaks lovingly to all beings

verses.devanagari:
यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवः
श्रमम् न अवाप्नुयात् किंचित् अप्रमत्ता तथा कुरु |
verses.iast:
yathā mayi tu niśhkrānte putraśokena pārthivaḥ
śramam na avāpnuyāt kiṃcit apramattā tathā kuru |
verses.translation: "While I take leave, take care of the king attentively so that he will not get fatigued even a little with grief over his son."

verses.devanagari:
दारुणश्चाप्ययम् शोको यथैनम् न विनाशयेत्
राज्ञो वृद्धस्य सततम् हितम् चर समाहिता |
verses.iast:
dāruṇaścāpyayam śoko yathainam na vināśayet
rājJṇo vṛddhasya satatam hitam cara samāhitā |
verses.translation: "Act always soothingly for a well-being of the aged king, seeing that his terrible grief will not destroy him ."

glosses.meaning: will not destroy in that way
of king vR^iddhasya = who is aged'

verses.devanagari:
व्रत उपवास निरता या नारी परम उत्तमा
भर्तारम् न अनुवर्तेत सा च पाप गतिर् भवेत् |
verses.iast:
vrata upavāsa niratā yā nārī parama uttamā
bhartāram na anuvarteta sā ca pāpa gatir bhavet |
verses.translation: �Even if a woman is interested in religious vows and fastings in addition to being the best of the excellent ;if she does not obey her husband she will become ill-fated !''

glosses.meaning: which woman vratopavaasanirataa = who is interested in voes and fastings paramothamaa = being the best of the excellent
will not attend to bhartaaram = husband saa = she

verses.devanagari:
भर्तुः शुश्रूषया नारी लभते स्वर्गमु त्तमम्
अपि या निर्नमस्कारा निवृत्ता देवपूजनात् |
verses.iast:
bhartuḥ śuśrūśhayā nārī labhate svargamu ttamam
api yā nirnamaskārā nivṛttā devapūjanāt |
verses.translation: �Even if a woman does not offer salutation to celestials and does not worship the gods, she will attain the highest heaven by service to her husband ."

verses.devanagari:
शुश्रूषम् एव कुर्वीत भर्तुः प्रिय हिते रता
एष धर्मः पुरा द्ऱ्ष्टः लोके वेदे श्रुतः स्म्ऱ्तः |
verses.iast:
śuśrūṣam eva kurvīta bhartuḥ priya hite ratā
eṣa dharmaḥ purā dRṣṭaḥ loke vede śrutaḥ smRtaḥ |
verses.translation: �She has to do service, truly devoted in love and welfare of her husband. This is seen in the world from the beginning, was heard from ancient texts and mentioned as righteousness.'

glosses.meaning: devoted in priyahite = love and welfare bhartuH of husband kurviita = she has to do sushruushhameva = service truly eshhaH = This dR^ishhTaH = is seen loke = in the world pure = before
was heard vede = in Vedas (ancient texts) smR^itaH = was told as dharmaH = righteousness.'

verses.devanagari:
अग्निकार्येषु च सदा सुमनोभिश्च देवताः
पूज्याः ते मत् क्ऱ्ते देवि ब्राह्मणाः चैव सुव्रताः |
verses.iast:
agnikāryeśhu ca sadā sumanobhiśca devatāḥ
pūjyāḥ te mat kRte devi brāhmaṇāḥ caiva suvratāḥ |
verses.translation: Oh, Mother! You always worship gods by sacrificial fire and by flowers for my sake . Brahmanas also with right voes are to be worshipped .'

verses.devanagari:
एवम् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व मम आगमन कान्क्षिणी
प्राप्स्यसे परमम् कामम् मयि प्रत्यागते सति |
verses.iast:
evam kālam pratīkṣasva mama āgamana kānkṣiṇī
prāpsyase paramam kāmam mayi pratyāgate sati |
verses.translation: "Look forward for the time of my return in such a manner with restraint, being temperate in food and being devoted in the service of your husband."

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्स्यसे परमम् कामम् मयि प्रत्यागते सति
यदि धर्मभ्ऱ्ताम् श्रेष्ठो धारयिष्यति जीवितम् |
verses.iast:
prāpsyase paramam kāmam mayi pratyāgate sati
yadi dharmabhRtām śreṣṭho dhārayiṣyati jīvitam |
verses.translation: "After my return, your best desire will be fulfilled if our father the best among protectors of righteousness ,is still alive till then."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु रामेण बाष्प पर्याकुल ईक्षणा
कौसल्या पुत्र शोक आर्ता रामम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu rāmeṇa bāṣpa paryākula īkṣaṇā
kausalyā putra śoka ārtā rāmam vacanam abravīt |
verses.translation: Kausalya who was afflicted with grief over her son, was with eyes full of tears after hearing Rama's utterances and spoke thus to Rama.

glosses.meaning: who is afflicted over her son

verses.devanagari:
गमने सुकृताम् बुद्धिम् न ते शक्नोमि पुत्रक
विनिवर्तयितुम् वीर नूनम् कालो दुरत्ययः |
verses.iast:
gamane sukṛtām buddhim na te śaknomi putraka
vinivartayitum vīra nūnam kālo duratyayaḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, Brave son! I am not able to avert your well-made resolution, in the matter of your going to forest. Time is inscrutable .It is certain."

glosses.meaning: in the matter of your going

verses.devanagari:
गच्च पुत्र त्वम् एक अग्रः भद्रम् ते अस्तु सदा विभो
पुनस्त्वयि निवृत्ते तु भविष्यामि गतक्लमा |
verses.iast:
gacca putra tvam eka agraḥ bhadram te astu sadā vibho
punastvayi nivṛtte tu bhaviśhyāmi gataklamā |
verses.translation: "Oh, son! You go undisturbed. Let there be auspiciousness always to you .I shall become refreshed, when you return again."

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्यागते महाभागे कृतार्थे चरितव्रते
पितुरानृण्यताम् प्राप्तेत्वयि लप्स्ये परम् सुखम् |
verses.iast:
pratyāgate mahābhāge kṛtārthe caritavrate
piturānṛṇyatām prāptetvayi lapsye param sukham |
verses.translation: "You, the illustrious after accomplishing a purpose, having observed a vow and having attained freedom from debt to your father, after having come again, I shall get great happiness".

glosses.meaning: You �mahaabhaage = the illustrious kR^itaarthe = who accomplished a purpose
who attained anR^iNyataam = freedom from debt pituH = to father
having come again lapsye = Ishall get varam = great sukham = happiness.

verses.devanagari:
कृतान्तस्य गतिः पुत्र दुर्विभाव्या सदा भुवि
यस्त्वा संचोदयति मे वच आच्चिद्य राघव |
verses.iast:
kṛtāntasya gatiḥ putra durvibhāvyā sadā bhuvi
yastvā saṃcodayati me vaca āccidya rāghava |
verses.translation: "The path of the destiny, which extinguishes my words and impels you to go to the forest ,is ever not imaginable on this earth"

glosses.meaning: which destiny Aachchhidya = extingvishes me = my vachaH = word sanchodayati = impels tvaa = you gatiH = the path kR^itaantasya = of such destiny sadaa = always durvibhaavyaa = is unimaginable bhuvii = on earth.

verses.devanagari:
गच्छेदानीम् महाबाहो क्षेमेण पुनरागतः
नन्दयिष्यसि माम् पुत्रः साम्ना वाक्येन चारुणा |
verses.iast:
gacchedānīm mahābāho kśemeṇa punarāgataḥ
nandayiśhyasi mām putraḥ sāmnā vākyena cāruṇā |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama the valiant !Go just now and come again safely, when you will rejoice me with your pleasing and tranquillising words ."

verses.devanagari:
अपीदानीम् स कालः स्स्याद्वनात्प्रत्यागतम् पुनः
यत्त्वाम् पुत्रकः पश्येयम् जटावल्कधारिणम् |
verses.iast:
apīdānīm sa kālaḥ ssyādvanātpratyāgatam punaḥ
yattvām putrakaḥ paśyeyam jaṭāvalkadhāriṇam |
verses.translation: "How good it will be, if today itself is the day of your returning from the forest, wearing twisted hair and garment made of bark."

glosses.meaning: wearing twisted hair and garment made of bark? saH kaalaH = That time

verses.devanagari:
तथा हि रामम् वन वास निश्चितम् |
ददर्श देवी परमेण चेतसा |
उवाच रामम् शुभ लक्षणम् वचो|
बभूव च स्वस्त्ययन अभिकान्क्षिणी
verses.iast:
tathā hi rāmam vana vāsa niścitam |
dadarśa devī parameṇa cetasā |
uvāca rāmam śubha lakṣaṇam vaco |
babhūva ca svastyayana abhikānkṣiṇī
verses.translation: "The queen kausalya thus saw Rama who decided to go to forest .She spoke these words with most excellent mind to Rama having auspicious qualities, being desirous of averting evil by recitation of auspicious words."

glosses.meaning: who decided to stay in forest
desirous of averting evil by recitation of auspicious words
